port.name: bat
port.description: Living Code for bat: TextMate .tmTheme syntax themes, also used by delta, in four color flavors.
port.quick: Install the tmTheme files into bat

guide.installation:
Requires [bat](https://github.com/sharkdp/bat). Download the four themes into bat's theme folder and rebuild its cache:

```sh
curl -fsSL --create-dirs --output-dir "$(bat --config-dir)/themes" -O "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/living-code-theme/bat/main/living-code-{night,frost,paper,signal}.tmTheme" && bat cache --build
bat --list-themes | grep living-code
```

Then pick a flavor with `--theme`, or make it the default in `$(bat --config-dir)/config`:

```sh
echo '--theme="living-code-night"' >> "$(bat --config-dir)/config"
```

**delta** reads its syntax themes from bat's cache. Use the [delta port](https://github.com/living-code-theme/delta): its install also adds these themes, and each delta flavor selects the matching syntax theme together with diff backgrounds, headers and gutters.

**Sublime Text** has its own native color scheme: use the [Sublime Text port](https://github.com/living-code-theme/sublime).

**Other tmTheme readers** (TextMate, syntect-based tools) can load the same `living-code-*.tmTheme` files directly.
guide.configuration: See [bat's documentation](https://github.com/sharkdp/bat#adding-new-themes) for application settings and reload behavior. Rerun `bat cache --build` after updating the theme files. The activation instructions above identify each supported flavor; keep your other application configuration.
guide.compatibility: This port supplies TextMate `.tmTheme` files, not bat itself. bat and delta load them from bat's theme cache; any other tmTheme reader can use the files directly.
